description: Specification for the CodeScope review CLI and supplied-evidence contract.

authoritativeFor: CodeScope CLI behavior, review and suggestion profiles, and supplied-evidence conventions.
notAuthoritativeFor: Eliware repository requirements, operational procedures, publication, deployment, or Test8 harness behavior.

crosslinks.authoritativeFor: Repository requirements consumed as supplied evidence.
CLI repository requirements consumed as supplied evidence.

dos: Provide a structured, read-only CLI for focused codebase reviews, suggestions, and token estimates.
Keep CLI behavior, review profiles, and supplied-evidence conventions explicit in CodeScope specifications.
donts: Do not define or enforce Eliware repository requirements owned by Conventions.
Do not define Operations procedures, publication or deployment behavior, or Test8 harness behavior.

dos: Document externally observable commands, options, output, exit behavior, review profiles, and evidence boundaries.
Treat supplied canonical convention records as review evidence and preserve their authority in Conventions.
Treat missing or unsupplied evidence as unknown rather than inventing requirements or claiming alignment.
donts: Do not present CodeScope-local review guidance as the authority for repository requirements, operations, publication, deployment, or harness behavior.

dos: Select convention evidence only from the repository's declared applicability and the canonical records supplied for review.
Keep review and suggestion profile behavior distinct and document the evidence each profile receives.
Keep reviewed repositories read-only and preserve safe output and documented controls.
donts: Do not infer convention applicability from repository shape, dependencies, or legacy records.
Do not mutate the reviewed repository as part of a review.
